dtsmartr UI/UX Design Mockup Specifications

Source: DESIGN_MOCKUP_SPECS.md

Document Purpose: Detailed visual specifications for implementing UX enhancements identified in the comparative analysis.
Target Version: dtsmartr v0.4.0
Last Updated: July 11, 2026

1. Compact Headers Mode (High Priority)

Problem Statement

Current headers consume 80-120px vertical space, reducing visible row count on laptop screens (1080p → only 8-10 rows visible).

Design Specification

1.1 Responsive Header Heights

/* Current (fixed height) */
.dtsmartr-header {
  height: 80px;
  padding: 16px 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* Proposed: Container query responsive */
.dtsmartr-grid-container {
  container-type: size;
  container-name: grid;
}

@container grid (max-height: 900px) {
  /* Compact mode for laptop screens */
  .dtsmartr-header {
    height: 40px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  
  .column-name {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  
  .column-type {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  
  .sparkline-container {
    height: 16px; /* Mini sparkline */
  }
  
  .missingness-bar {
    display: none; /* Show in tooltip only */
  }
}

@container grid (min-height: 1200px) {
  /* Detailed mode for large monitors */
  .dtsmartr-header {
    height: 120px;
    padding: 16px 12px;
  }
  
  .header-summary-stats {
    display: flex; /* Show mean, median, SD inline */
    font-size: 11px;
    gap: 12px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
  }
}

1.2 User-Configurable Density Toggle

UI Location: Top toolbar, next to theme selector

Implementation:

// React state
const [headerDensity, setHeaderDensity] = useState(
  localStorage.getItem('dtsmartr-header-density') || 'auto'
);

// Options: 'minimal' | 'auto' | 'detailed'
const HEADER_HEIGHTS = {
  minimal: 32,  // Name + type only
  auto: null,   // Responsive (container query)
  detailed: 120 // Full summary stats
};

// Apply to grid container
<div 
  className="dtsmartr-grid-container" 
  data-header-density={headerDensity}
>

Visual Design:

┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [≡ Minimal] [≡≡ Auto*] [≡≡≡ Detail] │  ← Toggle buttons
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
   32px       Responsive    120px

2. Conditional Sparkline Rendering (High Priority)

Problem Statement

Every numeric column shows a histogram sparkline, creating visual noise even for constant or low-variance columns.

Design Specification

2.1 Sparkline Visibility Logic

function shouldShowSparkline(column) {
  const { type, stats } = column;
  
  if (type !== 'numeric') return false;
  
  // Don't show sparkline if:
  const coefficientOfVariation = stats.stdDev / stats.mean;
  const uniqueValues = stats.cardinality;
  
  if (coefficientOfVariation < 0.1) {
    return { show: false, reason: 'constant', badge: `Constant: ${stats.mode}` };
  }
  
  if (uniqueValues === 2) {
    return { show: false, reason: 'binary', badge: `Binary: ${stats.distribution['0']}% / ${stats.distribution['1']}%` };
  }
  
  if (uniqueValues < 5) {
    return { show: false, reason: 'categorical', badge: `${uniqueValues} values` };
  }
  
  return { show: true };
}

2.2 Alternative Badges for Non-Sparkline Columns

Constant Value Badge:

<div class="header-badge badge-constant">
  <span class="badge-icon">📌</span>
  <span class="badge-text">Constant: 42</span>
</div>

Binary Value Badge (Pie Chart):

<div class="header-badge badge-binary">
  <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="var(--color-false)" />
    <path d="M12,12 L12,2 A10,10 0 0,1 22,12 Z" fill="var(--color-true)" />
  </svg>
  <span class="badge-text">60% / 40%</span>
</div>

CSS:

.header-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  background: var(--bg-muted);
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.badge-constant { border-left: 3px solid var(--color-gray); }
.badge-binary { border-left: 3px solid var(--color-purple); }

2.3 Muted Sparkline Colors

/* Current (high contrast) */
.sparkline-bar {
  fill: var(--accent-blue);
  opacity: 0.8;
}

/* Proposed (muted, reveal on hover) */
.sparkline-bar {
  fill: var(--neutral-400);
  opacity: 0.4;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.dtsmartr-header:hover .sparkline-bar {
  fill: var(--accent-blue);
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.sparkline-container {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 2px;
  background: var(--bg-sparkline);
}

3. Side-Panel Advanced Filter (High Priority)

Problem Statement

Current full-screen modal blocks the data grid. Users cannot see which rows match filters until they close the modal.

Design Specification

3.1 Layout Transformation

Before (Modal):

┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│   [X] Advanced Filter Modal      │
│                                  │
│   [Column ▼] [Operator ▼] [Value]│
│                                  │
│   [+ Add Condition]              │
│                                  │
│   [Cancel] [Apply]               │
└──────────────────────────────────┘
        (Blocks entire grid)

After (Side Panel):

┌────────────────────┬──────────────┐
│   DATA GRID        │ 🔍 Filters   │
│                    │              │
│  [Table rows...]   │ AGE > 50     │
│                    │ AND          │
│  [Highlighted      │ TRTGRP =     │
│   matching rows]   │ 'Active'     │
│                    │              │
│                    │ + Add        │
│                    │              │
│                    │ 142 of 1203  │
│                    │ [Apply]      │
└────────────────────┴──────────────┘
  70% width          30% width

3.2 Implementation

HTML Structure:

<div class="dtsmartr-container">
  <div class="dtsmartr-grid" style="width: 70%;">
    <!-- Virtualized grid -->

  <div class="dtsmartr-filter-panel" data-open="true" style="width: 30%;">
    <div class="panel-header">

3.3 Live Preview Highlighting

// As user builds filter, highlight matching rows
function previewFilter(filterExpression) {
  const matchingRowIndices = evaluateFilter(data, filterExpression);
  
  // Add temporary highlight class
  virtualGrid.updateRowClass((rowIndex) => {
    if (matchingRowIndices.includes(rowIndex)) {
      return 'row-filter-match';
    }
    return '';
  });
}
.row-filter-match {
  background: rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.15) !important;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--color-warning);
  animation: pulse-highlight 0.5s ease-out;
}

@keyframes pulse-highlight {
  0% { background: rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.4); }
  100% { background: rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.15); }
}

4. Shift+Click Multi-Column Sorting (High Priority)

Problem Statement

Current multi-column sorting requires opening a separate modal. Users expect modern spreadsheet-style Shift+Click behavior.

Design Specification

4.1 Interaction Pattern

Behavior: 1. Click column header → Single-column sort (current behavior) 2. Shift+Click additional headers → Add to sort chain 3. Click existing sorted column → Toggle ASC/DESC 4. Shift+Click sorted column → Remove from chain

Visual Indicators:

<div class="column-header" data-sort-index="1" data-sort-direction="asc">
  <span class="column-name">AGE</span>
  <span class="sort-badge">1️⃣ ↑</span>
</div>

<div class="column-header" data-sort-index="2" data-sort-direction="desc">
  <span class="column-name">TRTGRP</span>
  <span class="sort-badge">2️⃣ ↓</span>
</div>

4.2 CSS

.sort-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  background: var(--accent-blue);
  color: white;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-left: 4px;
}

.sort-badge::before {
  content: attr(data-sort-index);
  display: inline-block;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  border-radius: 50%;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 16px;
}

.column-header[data-sort-direction="asc"] .sort-badge::after {
  content: "↑";
}

.column-header[data-sort-direction="desc"] .sort-badge::after {
  content: "↓";
}

4.3 JavaScript Logic

const sortChain = [];

function handleColumnClick(columnName, event) {
  if (event.shiftKey) {
    // Add to sort chain or toggle existing
    const existingIndex = sortChain.findIndex(s => s.column === columnName);
    
    if (existingIndex >= 0) {
      // Toggle direction or remove
      const current = sortChain[existingIndex];
      if (current.direction === 'asc') {
        sortChain[existingIndex].direction = 'desc';
      } else {
        sortChain.splice(existingIndex, 1); // Remove from chain
      }
    } else {
      // Add new sort
      sortChain.push({ column: columnName, direction: 'asc' });
    }
  } else {
    // Reset to single-column sort
    sortChain.length = 0;
    sortChain.push({ column: columnName, direction: 'asc' });
  }
  
  applySortChain();
}

5. Improved Column Drag Ghost Preview (High Priority)

Problem Statement

Current drag ghost is semi-transparent (opacity 0.5), hard to see against light backgrounds.

Design Specification

/* Current */
.column-drag-ghost {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Proposed */
.column-drag-ghost {
  opacity: 0.95;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: rotate(2deg) scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: 
    0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  border: 2px solid var(--accent-blue);
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease-out;
  z-index: 1000;
}

.column-drag-ghost::after {
  content: "⚓";
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  right: 4px;
  font-size: 16px;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

/* Drop target indicator */
.column-drop-target {
  position: relative;
}

.column-drop-target::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -2px;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 4px;
  background: var(--accent-blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-blue);
  animation: pulse-drop-target 0.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse-drop-target {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scaleY(0.95); }
}

6. Typography Hierarchy Enhancements (High Priority)

Current Issues

  • Column names, data types, and values use similar font weights (400-500)
  • Reduced scannability, especially in wide datasets

Design Specification

/* Column Header Typography */
.column-name {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600; /* Was 500 */
  color: var(--text-primary);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.column-type {
  font-size: 12px; /* Was 13px */
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  opacity: 0.7; /* Was 0.85 */
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

/* Cell Value Typography */
.cell-value {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; /* Align numbers */
}

.cell-value.na {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    transparent,
    transparent 4px,
    rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.03) 4px,
    rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.03) 8px
  );
}

.cell-value.numeric {
  font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Monaco', 'Consolas', monospace;
  font-size: 12px;
  text-align: right;
}

.cell-value.date {
  font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Monaco', 'Consolas', monospace;
  font-size: 12px;
}

7.2 Tooltip Shortcut Hints

<!-- Before -->
<button title="Filter data">🔍</button>

<!-- After -->

7.3 First-Time Training Hints

// Show dismissible training hints on first interaction
const TRAINING_HINTS = {
  firstSort: "💡 Tip: Hold Shift and click another column to add it to the sort chain",
  firstFilter: "💡 Tip: Press Ctrl+F to quickly open filters",
  firstDrag: "💡 Tip: Drag column headers to reorder them"
};

function showTrainingHint(hintKey, message) {
  const shown = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dtsmartr-hints-shown') || '{}');
  
  if (!shown[hintKey]) {
    // Show tooltip near action
    showTooltip(message, { duration: 5000, dismissible: true });
    
    // Mark as shown
    shown[hintKey] = true;
    localStorage.setItem('dtsmartr-hints-shown', JSON.stringify(shown));
  }
}

WCAG AA Compliance Targets

Element Minimum Contrast Ratio Current Target

Large text (≥18px) 3:1 TBD 3:1
Active filter badges 4.5:1 TBD 4.5:1
NA cell text 3:1 TBD 3:1
Column headers 4.5:1 TBD 4.5:1

Proposed Dark Theme Palette

[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-primary: #1a1a1a;
  --bg-elevated: #242424;
  --bg-muted: #2a2a2a;
  --bg-hover: #303030;
  
  --text-primary: #ececec;    /* Contrast: 13.4:1 ✅ */
  --text-secondary: #b8b8b8;  /* Contrast: 7.2:1 ✅ */
  --text-muted: #8a8a8a;      /* Contrast: 4.6:1 ✅ */
  
  --border: #3a3a3a;
  --border-subtle: #2f2f2f;
  
  --accent-blue: #5b9eff;     /* Contrast: 6.1:1 ✅ */
  --accent-blue-hover: #7db3ff;
  
  --color-success: #52c41a;   /* Contrast: 5.2:1 ✅ */
  --color-warning: #faad14;   /* Contrast: 4.8:1 ✅ */
  --color-danger: #ff4d4f;    /* Contrast: 5.5:1 ✅ */
}

/* Zebra striping adjustment */
[data-theme="dark"] .row:nth-child(even) {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025); /* Was 0.05, too bright */
}

9. Row Density Toggle (Medium Priority)

Design Specification

UI Location: Top toolbar, next to header density toggle

Options: - Compact: 24px row height (power users, scanning mode) - Standard: 32px row height (default, balanced) - Comfortable: 40px row height (accessibility, presentations)

Implementation:

const ROW_HEIGHTS = {
  compact: 24,
  standard: 32,
  comfortable: 40
};

const [rowDensity, setRowDensity] = useState(
  localStorage.getItem('dtsmartr-row-density') || 'standard'
);

CSS:

.dtsmartr-grid[data-row-density="compact"] .cell {
  height: 24px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.dtsmartr-grid[data-row-density="standard"] .cell {
  height: 32px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
}

.dtsmartr-grid[data-row-density="comfortable"] .cell {
  height: 40px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
}

Keyboard Shortcuts: - Ctrl+Shift+[ → Compact - Ctrl+Shift+] → Comfortable - Ctrl+Shift+0 → Standard (reset)

10. Filter Persistence (Medium Priority)

Design Specification

10.1 LocalStorage Schema

const filterState = {
  datasetHash: hashCode(datasetName + nrow + ncol), // Unique dataset ID
  filters: [
    { column: 'AGE', operator: '>', value: 50 },
    { column: 'TRTGRP', operator: '=', value: 'Active' }
  ],
  timestamp: Date.now(),
  matchCount: 142
};

localStorage.setItem(
  `dtsmartr-filter-${filterState.datasetHash}`,
  JSON.stringify(filterState)
);

10.2 Restore Banner

On widget load, check for saved filters:

<div class="filter-restore-banner">
  <span class="banner-icon">🔍</span>
  <span class="banner-text">
    Restore previous filter? (142 rows match)
  </span>
  <button class="btn-primary-sm">Yes, restore</button>
  <button class="btn-secondary-sm">Start fresh</button>
  <button class="btn-icon" aria-label="Don't ask again">✕</button>
</div>

CSS:

.filter-restore-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--bg-info);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-info);
  animation: slide-down 0.3s ease-out;
}

@keyframes slide-down {
  from { transform: translateY(-100%); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
}
